infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1852004321 by maya

jin: quick hypothesis: a small set of malformed telemetry messages poisoned the Kafka consumer and stalled ingestion; with collectors stalled we lost observability of node churn while GPU quota hit, so autoscaler hit limits unseen
rob: good call. check Kafka lag on telemetry topic and consumer errors

sara: immediate mitigations suggested:
- route runtime traffic from ap-south-1 -> eu-west-1 (canary then full)
- pause non-critical batch/training jobs in ap-south-1
- patch otel-collector to discard malformed messages and increase local buffering
- enable temporary S3 sink for exporter batches for replay
rob: I'll also request quota uplift with cloud support, but that's multi-hour. reserved capacity in eu-west-1 is cheaper short-term than keeping customers degraded
alex: applying traffic shift now (canary 10% -> 100% once stable)
```
rbctl route update --from ap-south-1 --to eu-west-1 --weight 10%
rbctl route update --from ap-south-1 --to eu-west-1 --weight 100% --when-stable
```
maya: otel-collector patch I'm applying (snippet):
```
processors:
  batch:
    send_batch_size: 1024
exporters:
  kafka:
    max_buffered_records: 200000
    discard_on_malformed: true
  s3:
    bucket: telemetry-replay-temp
```
